metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: The Persona
records.biography_en: In The Inner Cast, The Persona takes the role of polished public face. “This is my meeting smile.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small smiling ivory stage mask held beside the visible real face.

records.name: The Shadow
records.biography_en: In The Inner Cast, The Shadow takes the role of quiet keeper of disowned things. “I thought you might want this back.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: rounded dark indigo mantle and a tiny discarded golden button.

records.name: The Trickster
records.biography_en: In The Inner Cast, The Trickster takes the role of playful rule bender. “I rolled the rulebook.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two mismatched dice tucked under one hand and crooked cap.

records.name: The Caregiver
records.biography_en: In The Inner Cast, The Caregiver takes the role of sturdy nurturing figure. “Keep the seed warm.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small blanket folded around a clay seed, independent hand-held prop.

records.name: The Old Guide
records.biography_en: In The Inner Cast, The Old Guide takes the role of patient guide. “One corner at a time.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short worn staff with a small amber lantern firmly attached.

records.name: The Self
records.biography_en: In The Inner Cast, The Self takes the role of relieved integrator. “All four pieces are here.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: four-color mandala medallion held at belly.
